_pitch:
Budgetly: an app that tracks your spending from your SMS and bank alerts and tells you where your money goes.
Free for basic tracking. Premium ₹99 a month or ₹799 a year: budgets, bill reminders, savings goals.
Your data stays on your phone. Works on Android and iPhone.

target: Young earners in India who want to control their spending
